properties.displayName: Network Session ASIM parser for Zscaler Private Access (ZPA_CL)
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool = false, pack:bool = false)
{
  ZPA_CL
  | where not(disabled)
  // Filter on the built-in column before parsing (ASIM performance guidance).
  // "ConnectionStatus" is present only on session logs, so this drops zpn_auth_log,
  // zpn_ast_auth_log, zpn_audit_log, zpn_sys_auth_log and the stats feeds.
  | where Message has "ConnectionStatus"
  | parse-kv Message as (
      SessionID: string,
      ConnectionID: string,
      InternalReason: string,
      ConnectionStatus: string,
      IPProtocol: double,
      Username: string,
      ServicePort: int,
      ServerPort: int,
      ClientPublicIP: string,
      ClientPrivateIP: string,
      ClientLatitude: real,
      ClientLongitude: real,
      ClientCountryCode: string,
      ClientCity: string,
      ClientZEN: string,
      Policy: string,
      Connector: string,
      ConnectorZEN: string,
      ConnectorIP: string,
      ConnectorPort: int,
      Host: string,
      ServerIP: string,
      Application: string,
      AppGroup: string,
      PolicyProcessingTime: string,
      ServerSetupTime: string,
      TimestampConnectionStart: string,
      TimestampConnectionEnd: string,
      ZENTotalBytesRxClient: long,
      ZENTotalBytesTxClient: long,
      Idp: string,
      Platform: string,
      Hostname: string
    ) with (pair_delimiter=',', kv_delimiter=':', quote='"')
  | where isnotempty(ConnectionStatus)
  | extend
      DvcAction = iif(InternalReason has_any ("REJECTED_BY_POLICY", "NO_POLICY_FOUND"), "Deny", "Allow"),
      EventResultDetails = case(
          isempty(InternalReason), "NA",
          InternalReason == "OPEN_OR_ACTIVE_CONNECTION", "NA",
          InternalReason in (
              "BRK_MT_TERMINATED",
              "BRK_MT_TERMINATED_IDLE_TIMEOUT",
              "MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_CLIENT_CLOSED",
              "MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_UPGRADE",
              "MT_CLOSED_TERMINATED",
              "BRK_MT_CLOSED_FROM_ASSISTANT",
              "BRK_MT_CLOSED_FROM_CLIENT",
              "ZIA_HALF_CLOSE_S"), "Terminated",
          InternalReason in (
              "APP_NOT_REACHABLE",
              "NO_CONNECTOR_AVAILABLE",
              "INVALID_DOMAIN",
              "AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_CONN",
              "AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_OPEN_SERVER_ERROR",
              "AST_MT_SETUP_ERR_NO_DNS_TO_SERVER",
              "BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_CANNOT_SEND_TO_DISPATCHER",
              "BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_APP_PORT_NOT_FOUND"), "Routing issue",
          InternalReason in (
              "AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_CANNOT_CONN_TO_BROKER",
              "AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_CANNOT_CONN_TO_SERVER",
              "AST_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT_NO_ACK_TO_BIND",
              "BRK_MT_SETUP_TIMEOUT"), "Timeout",
          InternalReason in (
              "BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
              "BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_REPEATED_DISPATCH"), "Maximum Retry",
          InternalReason == "MT_CLOSED_TLS_CONN_GONE_AST_CLOSED", "Invalid Tunnel",
          InternalReason == "BRK_MT_TERMINATED_BRK_SWITCHED", "Failover",
          InternalReason == "BRK_MT_SETUP_FAIL_SAML_EXPIRED", "Transient error",
          "Unknown"
      ),
      DstBytes = coalesce(ZENTotalBytesTxClient, long(0)),
      SrcBytes = coalesce(ZENTotalBytesRxClient, long(0)),
      SrcUsername = coalesce(Username, ""),
      NetworkDuration = toint(datetime_diff("millisecond",
          todatetime(TimestampConnectionEnd), todatetime(TimestampConnectionStart))),
      DstIsIp = isnotnull(parse_ipv4(Host))
  | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDstFQDN('Host')
  | extend
      DstHostname   = iif(DstIsIp, Host, DstHostname),
      DstDomain     = iif(DstIsIp, "", DstDomain),
      DstDomainType = iif(DstIsIp, "", DstDomainType),
      DstFQDN       = iif(DstIsIp, "", DstFQDN),
      DstIpAddr     = coalesce(ServerIP, iif(DstIsIp, Host, ""))
  | extend // --- Event ---
      EventCount     = int(1),
      EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(TimestampConnectionStart), TimeGenerated),
      EventEndTime   = coalesce(todatetime(TimestampConnectionEnd), TimeGenerated),
      EventType      = "NetworkSession",
      EventSubType   = case(
          ConnectionStatus =~ "open",  "Start",
          ConnectionStatus =~ "close", "End",
          ""),
      EventResult = iif(
          DvcAction == "Deny"
          or EventResultDetails in ("Routing issue", "Timeout", "Maximum Retry", "Invalid Tunnel"),
          "Failure", "Success"),
      EventOriginalResultDetails = InternalReason,
      EventSeverity      = iif(DvcAction == "Deny", "Low", "Informational"),
      EventVendor        = "Zscaler",
      EventProduct       = "Private Access",
      EventSchema        = "NetworkSession",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventUid           = _ItemId
  | extend // --- Reporting device ---
      Dvc               = Connector,
      DvcHostname       = Connector,
      DvcIpAddr         = ConnectorIP,
      DvcAction         = DvcAction,
      DvcOriginalAction = InternalReason
  | extend // --- Session ---
      NetworkSessionId = SessionID,
      SessionId        = SessionID,
      NetworkProtocol  = case(
          IPProtocol == 1,  "ICMP",
          IPProtocol == 6,  "TCP",
          IPProtocol == 17, "UDP",
          ""),
      Duration         = NetworkDuration,
      NetworkBytes     = DstBytes + SrcBytes,
      NetworkRuleName  = Policy,
      Rule             = Policy
  | extend // --- Source ---
      Src          = ClientPublicIP,
      SrcIpAddr    = ClientPublicIP,
      IpAddr       = ClientPublicIP,
      SrcNatIpAddr = ClientPrivateIP,
      SrcUsernameType = case(
          isempty(SrcUsername), "",
          indexof(SrcUsername, "@") > 0, "UPN",
          "Simple"),
      SrcUserType = case(
          isempty(SrcUsername), "",
          SrcUsername == "ZPA LSS Client", "Service",
          indexof(SrcUsername, "@") > 0, "Regular",
          "Other"),
      SrcHostname = Hostname,
      SrcDeviceType = case(
          Platform in~ ("windows", "mac", "linux"), "Computer",
          Platform in~ ("ios", "android"), "Mobile Device",
          isempty(Platform), "",
          "Other"),
      SrcDvcOs        = Platform,
      SrcGeoCountry   = ClientCountryCode,
      SrcGeoCity      = ClientCity,
      SrcGeoLatitude  = ClientLatitude,
      SrcGeoLongitude = ClientLongitude
  | extend // --- Destination ---
      Dst           = Host,
      Hostname      = DstHostname,
      DstPortNumber = toint(coalesce(ServicePort, ServerPort, 0)),
      DstAppName    = Application,
      DstAppType    = "Resource"
  | extend // --- Additional fields ---
      AdditionalFields = iif(pack, bag_pack(
          "ConnectionID",         ConnectionID,
          "AppGroup",             AppGroup,
          "Idp",                  Idp,
          "ClientZEN",            ClientZEN,
          "ConnectorZEN",         ConnectorZEN,
          "ConnectorPort",        ConnectorPort,
          "PolicyProcessingTime", PolicyProcessingTime,
          "ServerSetupTime",      ServerSetupTime), dynamic(null))
  | project
      TimeGenerated,
      EventCount,
      EventStartTime,
      EventEndTime,
      EventType,
      EventSubType,
      EventResult,
      EventResultDetails,
      EventOriginalResultDetails,
      EventSeverity,
      EventVendor,
      EventProduct,
      EventSchema,
      EventSchemaVersion,
      EventUid,
      Dvc,
      DvcHostname,
      DvcIpAddr,
      DvcAction,
      DvcOriginalAction,
      NetworkSessionId,
      SessionId,
      NetworkProtocol,
      NetworkDuration,
      Duration,
      DstBytes,
      SrcBytes,
      NetworkBytes,
      NetworkRuleName,
      Rule,
      Src,
      SrcIpAddr,
      IpAddr,
      SrcNatIpAddr,
      SrcUsername,
      SrcUsernameType,
      SrcUserType,
      SrcHostname,
      SrcDeviceType,
      SrcDvcOs,
      SrcGeoCountry,
      SrcGeoCity,
      SrcGeoLatitude,
      SrcGeoLongitude,
      Dst,
      DstHostname,
      DstDomain,
      DstDomainType,
      DstFQDN,
      DstIpAddr,
      Hostname,
      DstPortNumber,
      DstAppName,
      DstAppType,
      AdditionalFields,
      Type
};
parser (disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
